examples.arabic: اخويا بيشتغل على الكمبيوتر بتاعه والمطر شغال بره
examples.english: My brother works on his computer and the rain is falling outside.
examples.transliteration: Akhouya biyeshtaghal ala el computer betao wel matar shaghal barra.

examples.english: He is happy because he loves the rain.
Outside, the weather is a lot of rain.
The rain is a lot outside now.

examples.arabic: بعد الضهر الجو فيه مطر كتير
examples.english: In the afternoon, the weather has a lot of rain.
examples.transliteration: Ba'd el dohr el gaww feeh matar keteer

examples.arabic: بره فيه مطر كتير بس جوه البيت احنا قاعدين
examples.english: Outside there is a lot of rain, but inside the house we are sitting.
examples.transliteration: Barra feih matar kitiir bas gawwa el beit ehna qa3deen.
